title: Brand pack format and validator
description:
What: a JSON brand pack: name, logo, role colours for light and dark, fonts from an allow-list, sections, nav, home template, plus an image-style slot (links PPY-1f68bf) that accepts still pictograms. A validator applies the platform policy. Versioned schema.
Acceptance:
Scenario: A valid pack builds a branded site
  Given a pack with its own colours and font from the allow-list
  When the site builds in light and dark
  Then the brand shows and the policy checks pass
Scenario: A font outside the allow-list is rejected

comments.author: home
comments.text: Storage, fonts and the per-tenant stylesheet are PPY-e572de; the starter brand pack is PPY-3aa10f.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Plan note: brand pack v2 (slice 3 of docs/plans/shared-publication-front-end.md) adds shape.corners (square, soft, round), ornaments (none, quiet, expressive) and optional named role colours (MoM brand, machine, human; each contrast-checked). Sizes, spacing, borders stay refused. TheHallucinator.ai pack draft passes validate_brand_pack today (scratchpad hallucinator-pack.json; values in the plan).
